Results.ReviewText: The grill itself is great (this is easily the 5th or 6th Weber I've owned of one variety or another), however, after a single use the auto start button has failed.  I've contacted the seller (Jetmore, Wantagh NY) who helped me trouble shoot and will get me a new start mechanism, but the parts are back ordered and it could take up to 4 weeks to get the part.  There is a way to light the grill absent the button, but December in the Northeast is not an easy time to be using a long match to light a grill in windy 30 degree conditions.  Jetmore has been great to work with, but I am very surprised that the grill should suffer a failed starter after a single use.
Results.Title: Auto start button failure

Results.ReviewText: I finally bit the bullet and invested in a Weber Spirit gas barbecue. It replaced another manufacturer’s grill that had served us well for seven years. I couldn’t be happier with the upgrade. From the time I opened the carton and experienced how well everything was packed, I knew this was a different and higher level of quality. I’m an 80+year old guy, but I was able to assemble the unit basically by myself. It took me several hours, but the step by step directions were well illustrated and mostly easy to follow. A couple of times I had to get down on the deck and reach around to tighten a screw, so my cocktail that night was especially welcome! Firing up the grill and cooking on it are a dream. I bought a three burner unit to replace the four burner unit we had before and I’m delighted with it. Lots if cooking area and it heats up very quickly. Area heating is very consistent, which is one of the complaints I had with my other grill. I’ve only had the Spirit II for a few weeks so I’m still learning and experimenting,  but I’m looking forward to a long, happy and delicious relationship.
Results.Title: I’ve Got the Spirit!

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
